description: This file defines an abstract base class for rebalancing tests related to Orleans activation rebalancing, along with related interfaces and a simple grain implementation. It includes setup for test environment, managing silos, and measuring activation statistics.

classes.name: RebalancingTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for Orleans activation rebalancing tests, managing silos, cluster, and statistics.

classes.name: IRebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: Interface defining a rebalancing test grain with a Ping method.

classes.name: RebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: Simple grain implementation of IRebalancingTestGrain with a Ping method that completes immediately.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Counts how many activations a specific silo has based on statistics.

methods.name: AddTestActivations
methods.description: Adds a specified number of test grain activations on a given silo.

methods.name: CalculateVariance
methods.description: Calculates the variance of an array of integer values.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the test environment and forces activation collection.
